name: @samva/workspace
description: Open-source integration packages and examples for Samva.
author: Arya Labs, Inc.

scripts.version:packages: GH_TOKEN="$(gh auth token)" bun run tegami version
scripts.release:check: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run release:packages:check
scripts.release: bun run release:check && GH_TOKEN="$(gh auth token)" bun run tegami publish
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules .turbo coverage packages/*/dist examples/*/.next examples/*/.output examples/*/.wrangler examples/*/.svelte-kit examples/*/build
